text: Given a form with records across multiple statuses, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_list(form_id, status='completed', limit=1), Then only completed records for that form are returned and a nextCursor is present so a second page can be fetched
Given two different forms each with records, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_list(form_id=A), Then no record belonging to form B appears in the result

Given a known record_id, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_get(form_id, record_id), Then the full structured field data for that record is returned; given an unknown record_id, Then a not_found error envelope is returned instead of a raw exception

Given a published form, When an agent creates a record, then updates one field on it, then deletes it (with confirm=true), Then each step succeeds and a subsequent record_list no longer shows the deleted record
Given an existing record, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_delete without confirm=true, Then the call is rejected client-side with invalid_argument and no delete request reaches the Forms API
Given a successful record_create or record_get call, When the result is parsed as JSON, Then it contains explicit form_id and record_id fields (not just nested anonymously inside 'fields')

Given a form whose question definition marks a field required/choices-restricted, When an agent calls record_create/record_update with a missing required field or an out-of-choices value, Then the call returns invalid_argument (422 mapped) and a subsequent record_list shows no partially-written record

Given a record_id that belongs to tenant B, When an agent authenticated as tenant A calls record_get/record_list/record_update/record_delete with that id, Then the call returns not_found or unauthorized and the response body does not reveal the record's existence or content

Given the Ginko organization-mapping use case (a form with fields for NinjaOne/Huntress/IT Glue/HaloPSA/ConnectWise identifiers), When an agent runs the full record lifecycle (create one mapping record, update one system ID on it, list to confirm the change, delete it) using only the new record tools, Then every step succeeds without falling back to the Forms UI
steps: Stand up the backend's new record endpoints (dependency, see Tech design Risks & dependencies) against the INT environment, never PROD
Create a disposable test form in INT with fields matching the Ginko mapping use case (NinjaOne/Huntress/IT Glue/HaloPSA/ConnectWise org ids)
Call mspbots_forms_record_create with a full set of mapping values
Call mspbots_forms_record_update changing only the HaloPSA client id
Call mspbots_forms_record_list and confirm the record shows the updated value and the other fields unchanged
Call mspbots_forms_record_delete with confirm=true and confirm a subsequent record_get returns not_found
expect: All five calls succeed in order; the final record_get returns not_found; no step required opening the Forms UI

text: Given a form with N completed records, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_lookup(form_id, limit=50) and follows nextCursor across every page, Then every completed record is returned exactly once in stable order and the final total equals N

Given filter=[{field:'status',op:'eq',value:'Active'}] and fields=['client_name','rewst_org_id'], When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_lookup, Then only Active records are returned, each containing only the projected fields plus the _-prefixed system fields, and total reflects the filter
Given search='stroud' and searchFields=['client_name'], When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_lookup, Then only records whose client_name case-insensitively contains 'stroud' are returned
Given a normal mspbots_forms_record_lookup call, When the tool's declared outputSchema is used to validate the returned structuredContent, Then it always validates

Given an unknown form_id, or an unknown field name inside fields/filter/sort, When an agent calls mspbots_forms_record_lookup, Then a structured error (code+message) is returned, never a silently-empty list; given a record_id/form_id combination belonging to another tenant, Then the call returns not_found/unauthorized without leaking existence or content

Given a Forms dropdown question configured with choicesSource pointed at mspbots_forms_record_lookup, When the dropdown is opened in a real form, Then it loads options and cascades auto-fill from the selected record with no adapter code on the consumer side
steps: Confirm the backend list endpoint (dependency shared with TC9) exists in the target environment
Confirm with the Forms team whether choicesSource.type='mcp' dropdown wiring already exists in that environment (unverified by this design, see Open questions)
If both exist: configure a dropdown question's choicesSource to call mspbots_forms_record_lookup against the Ginko mapping form
Open the form and the dropdown in a browser; select an option
Confirm the dropdown lists the expected records and any configured downstream fields auto-fill from the selected record
expect: Dropdown loads the lookup tool's records as options and cascades auto-fill without any adapter/glue code
